prompt: Original generic modular vegetation; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. conifer-profile optional by region; region/species assumption, visual review required; use proper silhouette and leaf geometry, not low-quality filler Target bounding dimensions 5m wide x 8m high x 5m deep. Materials: leaf-neutral. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
